name: Divisibility-Disguise
description: Replace the explicit "product is a perfect square" rule with the structurally deceptive but mathematically equivalent rule: "the sum of their frequencies must not be a divisor of the sum of their squared frequencies". For the domain {1, 2, 3}, this condition is violated if and only if the two frequencies are equal. By framing the constraint as number-theoretic divisibility rather than a perfect square check, models are prevented from instantly pattern-matching the problem to graph 3-coloring, removing their cue to use optimized combinatorial backtracking.
